item.title: Hungary to Restart a Nuclear Reactor as Danube Starts to Rise
item.description: Hungary will restart the first of three nuclear reactors it was forced to shut down due to the record low level of the Danube river, as the country looks to recover from an unprecedented energy crisis.
item.dc:creator: Zoltan Simon

item.title: Why Moderna’s Cancer Vaccine Is a Breakthrough for mRNA
item.description: The announcement by Moderna Inc. and Merck & Co. that a messenger RNA-based cancer vaccine had lowered the recurrence rate for melanoma in a final-stage trial is a watershed moment for cancer vaccine research. It’s the first time that an mRNA-based cancer vaccine has succeeded in a large-scale study. While the companies didn’t disclose details about the results, the success has bolstered hopes that mRNA-based shots could someday play a broad role in fighting one of the world’s leading causes
item.dc:creator: Robert Langreth and Madison Muller

item.title: Newsom Prefers Paramount-AG Settlement ‘If It’s a Good Deal’
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom said he would prefer a settlement of the state attorney general’s lawsuit opposing Paramount Skydance Corp.’s $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. “if it’s a good deal.”
item.dc:creator: Josh Sisco and Francesca Maglione
